dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: Is it time to get some new Saurian whistles made...?

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: A general term for any instruments used to aid in communication between Saurians and humans.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: They're not standardized and entirely depend on the habits of the user and Saurians related to them.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: So long as it can be used for communication and so long as the user calls it a Saurian whistle, then it is one — doesn't matter if it's a harmonica, a whistle, or any other sound-making device.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: There are always new Saurian whelps being born to the tribe, and I'm just wondering whether or not I should make some ahead of time.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: Or perhaps, we can let the Saurians pick out the sound that they like best once they're older.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern. They can sometimes be stauncher than humans.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: Qucusaurs are very proud Saurians, so they never forget any decisions that they've made.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: So long as it can still spread its wings and fly, a Qucusaurus will never abandon a human companion it has recognized.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: The Flower-Feather Clan has survived to this day by relying on such human-Saurian cooperation. That's something that will never change even in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Mukki
dialogues.text: I lost. It looks like my deck hasn't acknowledged me yet.
